name: Image Follow Cursor
description: Large typographic link list where hovering a row reveals an image that follows the cursor with smooth easing, scaling in while the row text brightens and shifts.
contents: Stacked list of large text rows with optional small subtitle
behavior: Image follows the mouse with eased tracking inside the hovered row
Image fades and scales in on hover, inner image settles from a zoomed state
Row text color brightens and slides slightly right on hover
Subtitle appears on hover on screens 768px and wider
editableByProps: Row text, subtitles, links and images, number of rows
Background, text, hover, subtitle and divider colors
Typography classes, image size and aspect ratio, follow smoothness

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image reveal transition or easing
needsCodeEdit.where: transition-[opacity,scale] class on the preview image div

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the row text slide on hover

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Listens to window mousemove while mounted and removes it on unmount
Image follow relies on mouse hover, on touch devices a tap shows the image at the row without following
